producer_report.summary: Split crates/athena-data/src/records.rs by responsibility. Five new private submodules under records/ now hold the moved code, with no edits to it: core.rs (host errors, decision states, default expectations), introspection.rs (introspection, failure class, class label, proposal), work.rs (references, work items and decisions, audience rating, audit, code-health baseline), throughput.rs (throughput review, build measurement, Hestia sweep) and plan.rs (job plan, critique, baseline, replay). records.rs declares them with `mod` and re-exports them with `pub use self::<m>::*`, so every athena_data::records::* path is unchanged. The core types, AnyRecord, RecordError, check_record_file, is_job_dir and the tests module stay in records.rs. records.rs production code is now about 1416 raw lines before the test module, down from 3216. The first-pass code-health figure was 2543 counted lines, so the new figure is well under 1500; the largest new file (introspection.rs) is about 480 lines. Each new file starts with `use super::*;`. CHANGELOG.md has an entry under Unreleased/Changed.

criteria_check.evidence: records.rs has `pub use self::{core,introspection,plan,throughput,work}::*`. `cargo check --workspace --all-targets` passed with no edits outside athena-data.

criteria_check.criterion: The diff only moves code: no changes to serde attributes, schema constants, field types, or function bodies, checkable with git diff.
criteria_check.evidence: I wrote each new file's bodies from the original text and deleted exactly those ranges from records.rs. The only additions are the module header comments, `use super::*;` and the mod/pub use block. All 186 tests pass, including the record round-trip tests.

criteria_check.criterion: AnyRecord, check_record_file and RecordError remain in records.rs and still cover every moved record type.
criteria_check.evidence: I did not edit those items. They compile against the re-exported types, and the athena-data tests pass.

open_issues: I did not run the whole-workspace clippy or the full `cargo test --locked`; Athena runs both. Only athena-data was linted and tested, and the other crates were only compile-checked.
`cargo test -p athena-cli --test mirrors` was not run. I did not look for that file, and the change touches none of the mirrored sources.
learnings: records.rs is about 5400 lines in total; the tests module takes most of it, from line 1417 now (previously 3216).
Child modules reach the parent's imports and private items through `use super::*`. The glob re-exports from sibling modules also work, so no cross-module import edits were needed.
A child module named `core` compiled without trouble beside serde's derive output.
desires: A shell-free way to move line ranges between files. Each moved block had to be retyped twice: once to write the new file and once to delete it from the old one.
